0022600192.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (6-2, 4-0 at home) host the Washington Wizards (4-4) with the Thunder second in the Northwest, half a game ahead of... no. Let me restate that precisely: the Thunder are 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and 4th in the West, riding a two-game win streak and a 6-2 record over their last ten, while the Wizards are 8th in the East, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, and coming off a loss. Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams, Nikola Topic and Thomas Sorber, and Washington is without Anthony Davis, Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman and Tristan Vukcevic. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 132-111 win in Washington on March 21, 2026.
